notes: Baseline 4 → 6 after Wave A. Verified live via get_advisors(security) on 2026-08-13.
5× lint 0029 (authenticated can execute SECURITY DEFINER): get_clerk_user_id, get_current_user_id, get_next_invoice_number, my_firm_ids, accessible_client_ids.

lint 0029 is accepted for my_firm_ids and accessible_client_ids: both are SECURITY DEFINER helpers invoked from RLS policies as the authenticated role. GRANT EXECUTE to authenticated is required for those policies to evaluate; EXECUTE is already revoked from anon/public. Same accepted pattern as get_current_user_id. Do not 'fix' 0029 by revoking authenticated — that breaks tenancy.
Performance advisors are tracked separately and are not a failing gate.
Every new table migration must include `revoke all on <table> from anon` — Supabase defaults GRANT ALL TO anon.
